QUOTE: The error is only logged at debug level (`logDebug`). The function returns `{data: true}` either way, so the caller is not told the send failed.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that `createPost` returns `{data: true}` even on failure, so the caller isn't told, while the failure shows up only as `props.failed = true` on the stored post.
